draft.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
draft.description: Quick and vibrant stir-fried chicken with colorful vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch slurry to make the sauce.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat until very hot.
Add the diced chicken and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until cooked through and golden. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the wok, then add garlic and ginger. Stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the harder vegetables first: carrots and broccoli. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the bell pepper slices and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Return the cooked chicken to the wok with all the vegetables.
Pour in the prepared sauce and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until the sauce coats all ingredients and thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Garnish with spring onion if desired.
Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.

draft.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
draft.description: A classic Italian pasta dish with a rich, savory meat sauce made with tomatoes, garlic, and herbs.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned (about 5-6 minutes).
Stir in the canned tomatoes, dried oregano, and dried basil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente.
Drain pasta and divide among serving bowls.
Top each serving with bolognese sauce and grated parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately.

draft.name: Banana bread
draft.description: A moist and delicious quick bread made with ripe bananas, perfect for breakfast or a sweet treat.
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a loaf pan.

Beat in the eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Stir in the mashed bananas.
In another bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined.

draft.name: Pancakes
draft.description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes made with simple ingredients, perfect for a family breakfast.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter until well combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. The batter should be slightly lumpy.
Heat a non-stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour about 60 ml of batter onto the pan for each pancake and cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Serve warm with your choice of toppings such as maple syrup, berries, or whipped cream.

draft.name: Baked Salmon with Lemon
draft.description: Tender salmon fillets baked with fresh lemon and herbs for a simple, elegant meal.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a lined baking sheet.
Drizzle salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Scatter minced garlic and fresh dill over the salmon.
Top each fillet with a few lemon slices and a small knob of butter.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately with the baked lemon slices alongside.

draft.name: 番茄炒蛋
draft.description: 经典的番茄和鸡蛋搭配，简单快手的家常菜。
steps: 将番茄洗净，去蒂后切成块状；鸡蛋打入碗中，加入少许盐打匀。
热锅下油，将打好的鸡蛋倒入，炒至半凝固时盛出备用。
锅中再加油，放入葱段和姜片爆香，然后倒入番茄块翻炒。
炒至番茄出汁软烂后，加入糖调味，再放回炒好的鸡蛋。
轻轻翻炒均匀，使番茄和鸡蛋充分混合，最后根据口味调整盐的用量即可出锅。

draft.name: 麻婆豆腐
draft.description: 四川经典豆腐菜，用肉末和豆腐在麻辣酱汁中炖煮。
steps: 将豆腐切成约2厘米见方的块，轻轻沥干水分。
热锅下油，炒猪肉末至变色，盛起备用。
锅中再加油，放入姜末和蒜末爆香。
加入豆瓣酱、花椒粉和少量辣椒粉（约0.5茶匙）炒香，避免过辣。
倒入清汤或清水，加入生抽和糖，烧至微沸。
轻轻放入豆腐块，用小火煮5-8分钟，让豆腐吸收汤汁的味道。
放回炒好的肉末，搅拌均匀，继续煮2分钟。
将淀粉水倒入，边倒边搅拌至汤汁浓稠。
尝味道并根据需要调整盐和花椒粉。
盛入碗中，撒上葱段和少许花椒粉装饰。

draft.name: 猪肉白菜饺子
draft.description: 传统的猪肉白菜馅饺子，皮薄馅鲜，适合全家享用。
steps: 将中筋面粉、盐和温水混合，揉搓成光滑面团，盖布静置30分钟。
白菜切碎后撒盐腌10分钟，挤干多余水分。
猪肉绞碎，加入白菜碎、葱段、姜末、酱油、麻油、食用油和白胡椒粉，混合均匀制成馅料。
面团分成约40个小剂子，每个约7克。
取一个小剂子，用手掌压扁，用擀面杖擀成直径约7厘米的圆皮。
在饺子皮中心放约12克馅料。
将饺子皮对折成半圆，边缘捏紧。
用拇指和食指在半圆边缘捏出褶皱，完成包装。
烧水至沸腾，放入饺子。
饺子浮起后再煮2-3分钟，即可出锅。
盛入碗中，配上醋或其他蘸料享用。

draft.name: 葱油拌面
draft.description: 简单快手面食，用香葱油拌匀面条，香气四溢，味道鲜美。
steps: 将葱切成段，放入碗中。
烧热油至冒烟，倒入葱段中炸香，静置让葱油充分浸出香味。
将面条放入沸水中煮至熟透，通常需要8-10分钟。
面条煮好后沥干，放入大碗中。
将葱油、酱油、糖和鸡精倒入面条中。
加入适量盐调味。
用筷子快速翻拌，让每根面条都均匀裹上葱油。
盛入碗中，可按喜好加入榨菜或其他配菜，立即享用。

draft.name: 玉米排骨汤
draft.description: 一道营养丰富的清汤，用新鲜玉米和猪排骨慢火炖制，汤汁清甜，适合全家享用。
steps: 将猪排骨洗净沥干，放入沸水中焯烫2分钟，取出冲洗干净。
玉米洗净后切成4-5厘米长的段。
红枣洗净并去核，生姜切片。
在砂锅或高压锅中加入清水，放入处理好的排骨、玉米、红枣和生姜片。
大火烧开后转小火，炖60-90分钟至排骨软烂，汤色清甜。
最后根据口味加入适量食盐调味即可。
盛入碗中，稍微放凉后即可给小孩享用。

draft.name: Chicken Stir-fry
draft.description: A quick and vibrant stir-fry with tender chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a savory sauce.
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over high heat.
Add the sliced chicken breast and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken to the pan.
Pour the sauce mixture over the chicken and vegetables.
Toss everything together for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly and coated all ingredients.
Serve hot, optionally over rice or noodles.

draft.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
draft.description: A classic Italian-inspired pasta dish featuring a savory meat sauce served over spaghetti.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and carrot, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Increase heat and add the ground beef, browning it completely while breaking up clumps with a spoon.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the tomato passata and add the dried oregano.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 20 minutes to develop flavors.
While the sauce simmers, bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain the pasta and serve immediately topped with the Bolognese sauce.

draft.name: Butternut Squash Soup
draft.description: A creamy, smooth, and comforting vegetarian soup perfect for cold evenings.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the cubed butternut squash and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable broth until the squash is covered.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the squash is fork-tender.
Remove from heat and blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with herbs.

draft.name: Classic Banana Bread
draft.description: A moist, flavorful, and simple homemade banana bread perfect for breakfast or snacks.
steps: Preheat your oven to 175°C and grease a standard loaf pan.
In a large mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth.
Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas.
Mix in the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in.
Gently fold in the flour until just combined; do not overmix.
Pour the batter into your prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, or until a tester inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

draft.name: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
draft.description: These light and airy pancakes are the perfect base for your favorite breakfast toppings.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate jug, mix the milk, beaten egg, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; do not overmix, as lumps are okay.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and lightly grease with butter or oil.
Pour approximately 60ml of batter onto the pan for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, then flip.
Cook the other side until golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes more.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm.

draft.name: 番茄炒蛋
draft.description: 一道经典的家常菜，酸甜可口，营养丰富。
steps: 将鸡蛋打入碗中，加入少许盐搅打均匀。
锅中倒入食用油，烧热后倒入蛋液，翻炒至凝固成块，盛出备用。
锅中留底油，下入番茄块翻炒，用铲子按压出汁。
如果番茄比较酸，可加入少许番茄酱翻炒。
将炒好的鸡蛋倒入锅中，与番茄翻炒均匀。
调入盐，撒上葱花即可出锅。

draft.name: 麻婆豆腐
draft.description: 一道经典的川菜，口感滑嫩，滋味浓郁，适合家常食用。
steps: 锅中倒入植物油，烧热后放入猪肉末炒至变色。
加入蒜末、姜末和豆瓣酱，中小火炒出香味和红油。
加入适量的清水（没过食材即可），倒入生抽调味。
放入豆腐块，轻轻推匀，不要大力翻炒以免豆腐破碎。
转小火焖煮约3-5分钟，让豆腐入味。
淋入水淀粉勾芡，待汤汁浓稠后即可关火。
撒上葱花装饰，盛出装盘即可食用。

draft.name: 高压锅版红烧肉
draft.description: 软糯入味、色泽红亮的经典红烧肉，用高压锅烹饪更加快捷软烂。
steps: 将五花肉切成3厘米见方的块，冷水入锅，加入少许料酒和姜片，焯水捞出沥干。
高压锅中放入少量油，加入冰糖，小火炒出琥珀色的糖色。
将焯过水的五花肉倒入锅中，快速翻炒，使肉块均匀上色。
加入生抽、老抽翻炒均匀，放入葱段、姜片、八角。
倒入足量的清水（没过肉块即可），盖上高压锅盖。
大火烧开上汽后转中小火，压制约15-20分钟。
关火等待自然泄压，打开锅盖，如果汤汁较多，可转大火收汁至浓稠即可出锅。

draft.name: 猪肉白菜饺子
draft.description: 经典鲜美的猪肉白菜馅饺子，外皮劲道，内馅多汁。
steps: 将切碎的大白菜撒入少量盐，腌制10分钟后挤干水分备用。
在一个大碗中放入猪肉末，加入生抽、老抽、姜末、葱末、食用油和芝麻油，朝一个方向搅拌上劲。
将挤干水分的大白菜加入肉馅中，充分混合均匀，制成饺子馅。
取一张饺子皮，在中心放入适量馅料。
沿边缘沾少许水，对折并捏紧边缘，封口成型。
锅中烧开足量的水，下入饺子。
煮至饺子浮起，加入一小碗冷水，再次煮开，重复两次后即可捞出。

draft.name: 葱油拌面
draft.description: Classic Shanghai-style scallion oil noodles featuring crispy fried scallions and a savory, aromatic soy sauce base.
steps: 将小葱洗净，沥干水分，切成长段。
锅中倒入食用油，冷油下入葱段，用中小火慢慢炸。
炸至葱段呈深褐色且发出焦香味，关火捞出葱段备用。
在锅中剩余的葱油里加入生抽、老抽和白糖，小火加热搅拌均匀，煮沸后关火制成葱油汁。
另烧一锅水，水开后放入面条煮熟，捞出沥干水分。
将煮好的面条放入碗中，淋上熬好的葱油汁，拌匀。
最后在面上放上炸好的葱段作为点缀，即可食用。

draft.name: 玉米排骨汤
draft.description: 这是一道非常适合儿童食用的清淡滋补汤品，排骨软烂，玉米清甜。
steps: 将猪小排冷水下锅，加入两片姜，大火煮开后撇去浮沫，捞出用温水冲洗干净沥干。
将处理好的排骨放入砂锅或炖锅中，加入足够量的清水和剩余姜片。
大火煮沸后转小火，盖上盖子焖煮约45分钟，直到排骨肉质变软。
加入切好的胡萝卜块和玉米段，继续小火炖煮20至30分钟，直到玉米和胡萝卜熟透变软。
最后加入少量食盐调味，搅拌均匀即可关火食用。

draft.name: 宫保鸡丁 (无花生版)
draft.description: 一道经典的川菜，以滑嫩的鸡肉和酸甜微辣的酱汁为主，此版本去除了花生。
steps: 鸡丁加入少许料酒和淀粉，抓匀腌制15分钟。
将酱油、陈醋、白糖和一半水淀粉混合成调味汁。
热锅倒油，放入花椒和干辣椒段，小火炒出香味。
放入鸡丁，大火快速翻炒至变色。
加入葱段、姜片和蒜片，翻炒出香味。
倒入事先调好的碗汁，快速翻炒均匀。
待酱汁浓稠包裹住鸡丁后，即可关火装盘。

draft.name: Classic Vegetable Fried Rice
draft.description: A quick and savory stir-fry dish perfect for repurposing leftover cooked rice with fresh vegetables.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and diced carrots, stir-frying for 2 minutes until softened.
Push the vegetables to the side of the pan and pour in the beaten eggs, scrambling them until cooked through.
Add the cold leftover rice to the pan, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the frozen peas and soy sauce, mixing everything together until well combined and heated through.
Remove from heat and garnish with sliced spring onions before serving.

draft.name: Comforting Weekend Pancakes
draft.description: Classic fluffy pancakes perfect for a slow and relaxing weekend morning breakfast.
steps: Whisk together flour, baking powder, and sugar in a large bowl.
Mix in the milk, egg, and melted butter until just combined; do not overmix.
Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles appear on the surface, then flip and cook until golden brown.
Serve immediately with your favorite toppings.

draft.name: Classic Scrambled Eggs
draft.description: A simple and fluffy breakfast staple perfect for a quick start to the day.
steps: In a bowl, whisk the eggs and milk until well combined and slightly frothy.
Melt the butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan.
Let the eggs sit for a few seconds until the edges begin to set.
Gently push the eggs across the pan with a spatula, creating soft curds.
Continue cooking and stirring until the eggs are cooked through but still moist.
Remove from the heat immediately, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
